newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ stopwork meetings a signal - union.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ stopwork meetings a signal - union.

text.p: Finance Sector Union (FSU) joint national secretary Tony Beck said on Wednesday that stopwork meetings by staff at Australia and New Zealand Bank Ltd planned for Friday signalled a more strategic and active position by the FSU on job security and industry restructuring.

In a statement, the FSU said its members were demanding ANZ put into place a proper process for redundancy and redeployment and to commit to an ongoing investment in training staff and working in a cooperative manner over workplace restructuring.
"This stopwork action has been demanded by the members, to indicate to the finance sector that job security and workplace dignity are of vital importance to staff," Beck said.

The union, which represents 110,000 financial industry workers, is holding stopwork meetings for ANZ members on Friday in every major city and several regional centres in response to what it sees as threats of massive job losses and branch closures. The union said it has experienced strong growth in union membership at the bank.
"The union is waiting for the bank to respond to members' concerns," the FSU said.
